Independently bounded tail mean by 31/10^6 and variance by 23/10^10 from prime sums and integrals; one-sided Chebyshev gives tail compensation probability <3/5000. Independence follows from fixed CRT cylinders and negligible far-prime expectation. Thus the deficient set has lower density >55081931/250000000 and upper density of strict excess <194918069/250000000. Executed standalone checker verifies finite sums and 6595 independent implication cases; no appeal to finite sampling for infinity.
